title: [review] slot_claim.py:351: Unbounded memory allocati
description: compute_interleaved_slots (line 351) and compute_contiguous_slots (line 387) convert range() to list() without limiting the resulting list size. With max_slots or slot_count set to very large values (e.g., 2**31), these functions could allocate gigabytes of memory causing denial of service. Fix: add a reasonable upper bound check (e.g., MAX_SLOTS_PER_CLAIM = 65536) before creating the list.
